title: Honkaku Hanafuda
overview: Honkaku Hanafuda is a digital version of three popular two-player card games played with Japanese hanafuda cards: Koi-Koi, Hana-Awase, and Oicho-Kabu. The game includes a story mode where the player meets different characters and must defeat them at the various games, and a free battle mode where the player can select any game type and play against the computer. There are eight different computer opponent characters, and a variety of game rule settings for each game type, as well as a basic tutorial that explains how each of the included games are played.
